name: sealed-behavior-v1
description: 24 frozen sealed-profile scenarios: six simple facts, six conditions or corrections (the frozen source-separation qualifiers Q01 to Q06), six multi-source cases and six source-only or quotation requests. Each stored memory is admitted; each source_only value is stored only in the sealed source passage. A case passes when every required admitted text is in the packed context, no source-only value appears anywhere in the response, and a source-only or quotation request reports that the source is unavailable. Default retrieval excludes a conditional fact whose condition is unresolved, in every store (prme.retrieval.filtering), so the three conditional cases are asked in explicit mode; the test also records their default-mode exclusion.
